entry.name: Greninja-S
entry.flavor: The movement of air against the long tongue Greninja keeps wrapped around its neck allows it to sense enemies it can't see.
entry.flavorEs: Aparece y desaparece de improvisto, cual ninja. Marea al oponente con su soberbia agilidad y lo hace trizas con sus Shuriken de Agua.

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Agua cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Agua infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其水属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Água infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.
abilities.textEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
abilities.detail: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.
abilities.detailEs: Cambia el tipo del portador para que coincida con cada movimiento que usa. El cambio de tipo se produce justo antes de usar el movimiento.
abilities.detailZh: 持有该特性的宝可梦的属性会变为与其使用的每个招式相同。属性变化在招式使用前一刻发生。
abilities.detailPt: Muda o tipo do portador para corresponder a cada movimento que ele usa. A mudança de tipo ocorre logo antes de o movimento ser usado.
